lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern across the mid-section, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a lattice of anchor nodes along the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features showing high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries running parallel along the dorsal-lateral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-intensity white spots visible against the darker macro-mask of the dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch or tissue loss on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
